![The Ask.com wordmark. Image from [Ask.com](https://www.ask.com/).](cover.jpg){fig-align="center"}

The [Ask.com farewell page](https://www.ask.com/) is just a one-screen notice that the search engine closed on May 1, 2026, after 25 years, and that [IAC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/InterActiveCorp) "continues to sharpen its focus" away from the business.

## My Notes

Remember the days when asking a natural-language query felt so much more novel and exciting than trying to come up with a bunch of keywords? That was so 1996!

Godspeed, Ask.com (and Jeeves)!
